title: Use Group III – additional provisions for parking requirement category

blocks.plainText: For permitted uses denoted with “*” for parking requirement category (PRC) in Section 32-131 (Use Group III – general use allowances), the following provisions shall apply:

blocks.html:
1. Non-profit hospital staff dwellings shall be subject to parking requirements applicable to residences, in accordance with Section 36-024 (Applicability of regulations to non-profit hospital staff dwellings).
  2. For colleges, universities or seminaries, the portion of such facility that is used for classrooms, laboratories, student centers or offices shall be classified as PRC G. The portion of such facility that is used for theaters, auditoriums, gymnasiums or stadiums shall be classified as PRC B2.
